title: In a world no one forecast, own a business that outlives presidential social posts: 6 large-cap stocks with upside potential of up to 29%
summary: For quite some time now, it has become increasingly hard to make sense of what is happening in the world. The old understanding of what is sensible and nonsensical has vanished, and things once kept hidden in the darkest corners are now done openly by those in charge of the most powerful places on earth. So, for the next two-and-a half years, until this phase of global politics runs its course, we will continue to see the kind of surprises that no business can plan for.
